acceptanceCriteria: Cargo metadata and lockfile report v0.2.38 consistently.
The reviewed release workflow, release policy, documentation, and staged adopter regression checks pass before the immutable tag.
The v0.2.37 N-1 Git identity failure is covered by a repository-local identity regression and no global Git configuration is required.
The post-release public artifact, installed binary, adopter isolation, and N-1 upgrade acceptance are explicitly handed off to a successor acceptance Work Item and are not claimed before publication.
Merge, finalization, close, and exact branch/worktree cleanup leave the repository ready on the synchronized default branch.
Closed WI-365 tri-language Work Item projections report implemented status consistently with their terminal evidence and parity rows.
goal: Prepare a reproducible v0.2.38 public release from synchronized main, root-fix the N-1 release failure, and hand off immutable public-artifact acceptance without claiming unpublished evidence.
intent: Prepare v0.2.38 from the reviewed synchronized main after root-fixing the v0.2.37 N-1 release failure; publish only after this Work Item is reviewed and hand off post-release acceptance to a successor.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Workspace metadata, lockfile, tri-language release/versioning docs, parity projection, and staged release/adopter checks are consistent before tagging.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: release metadata and staged policy checks
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run cargo metadata/check, documentation acceptance, parity status, and adopter harness static/regression tests.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The upgrade harness commits after cloning with no usable global Git identity by configuring repository-local identity.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run adopter_upgrade_acceptance_test.sh with isolated HOME/XDG and GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Public artifact identity and fresh-adopter acceptance are reserved for a successor Work Item bound to the immutable published tag.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Record the successor Work Item and post-release acceptance command in the release documentation without claiming unpublished evidence.
